classification.OPEN: Audited candidate that still requires implementation or exact adjudication.
classification.FIXED: Verified in source and by the named automated or browser evidence.
classification.CONFIRMED_RAW: Verified business, user, Agent, provider, identifier, path, or diagnostic content that must remain verbatim.
classification.THIRD_PARTY_CONSTRAINED: Owned by an external runtime or protocol and not safely alterable by FirmDeck.
classification.UNVERIFIED: Not exercised against the real runtime, provider, role, platform, or integration.

baseline_metrics.note: Metrics are discovery signals, not a count of user-visible defects. The governance checkers classify syntax and sink context before blocking.

findings.summary: The legacy source-key catalog was removed; en-US and zh-CN now use typed semantic IDs, named ICU parameters, exact key parity, and generated en-XA coverage.
findings.target: BCP 47 catalogs with stable English semantic IDs, named ICU parameters, en-US canonical structure, and exact zh-CN parity.

findings.summary: The global MutationObserver, WeakMaps, numeric placeholders, source-key runtime, and legacy provider were removed; React and controlled imperative sinks localize before display.
findings.target: React render-time semantic messages plus imperative translation for controlled non-DOM sinks.

findings.summary: Repository-wide product sinks now use typed semantic descriptors, including JSX, attributes, toast, native dialog, clipboard, download, title, iframe, postMessage, trace, and accessibility text.
findings.target: Typed semantic descriptors at every product-owned sink; external/raw payload fields stay raw.

findings.summary: Broad ignore attributes were removed or replaced by narrow RawContent/RawIdentifier boundaries; user, Agent, provider, document, path, identifier, and successful tool content remain verbatim.
findings.target: Small RawContent wrappers or validated reason-bearing attributes; no file, route, or container-wide ignore.

findings.summary: Date, time, number, percentage, units, list formatting, pluralization, and collation now use explicit current locale and timezone inputs; fixed-locale and manual-formatting checker diagnostics are zero.
findings.target: One locale-aware formatter facade using current locale plus explicit timezone and currency inputs.

findings.boundary: persistent session titles and team blackboard content
findings.summary: User-visible session titles and blackboard bodies no longer carry product-language machine wrappers: stable session_kind stores execution type, titles/body preserve raw business content, and provenance is structured metadata; old title prefixes are accepted only by an exact compatibility boundary.
findings.target: Stable machine kind fields remain independent from raw/user-visible titles and content; exact legacy parsing is temporary, additive, and removal-tracked.
verification: additive SQLite migration and exact legacy backfill tests

findings.summary: Public errors now project registered code, exact safe params, retryability, and private diagnostics; unknown or malformed errors fail closed without raw exception/provider prose.
findings.target: Registered code plus safe named params, retryable, request/trace identifiers, and private diagnostic cause; frontend localizes known codes.

findings.summary: Product stream, task, team, channel, Harness recovery, public-job, and trace states use registered event_code plus exact params; legacy Harness text/status projections are accepted only by an exact allowlist and bounded compatibility record.
findings.target: Registered versioned product events with safe params and a bounded deprecated text projection.

findings.summary: UI locale and Agent reply locale are independently modeled in an immutable LanguageContext persisted and replayed across web, stream, retry, recovery, handoff, scheduled, team, channel/public, General Skill, Tool, and local A2A paths.
findings.target: Immutable LanguageContext with independent ui_locale and agent_reply_locale, persisted before durable execution and replayed without re-resolution.
verification: real-model behavior remains UNVERIFIED until exercised

findings.summary: Active Agent, Harness, response, summary, scheduled, title, General Skill, Skill authoring, memory, and local A2A prompt stages receive the immutable reply-locale contract plus raw-source markers.
findings.target: Every active and compatibility stage receives reply-locale rules plus explicit raw-source markers.

findings.summary: Fixture-driven TypeScript/catalog and Python AST governance now covers product sinks, accessibility, non-DOM APIs, fixed locale/manual formatting, broad ignores, catalog drift, backend errors/events, raw leaks, and Agent language prompts.
findings.target: Fixture-driven TypeScript and Python AST checks plus catalog/ICU/parameter/usage validation with stable diagnostics.
verification: positive and negative fixtures for every required sink

reconciliation_policy.completion_rule: No OPEN finding may remain when completion is claimed. UNVERIFIED items are reported, never silently treated as fixed.
reconciliation_policy.evidence_rule: FIXED requires a source change or explicit no-change adjudication plus named automated or browser evidence.
